ticket.subject: Feature idea: Gantt charts
ticket.body_text:
Hi folks,

Writing on behalf of Nimbleford Dental. Please consider adding a Gantt chart view; we plan long projects with many steps.

Right now we export to a spreadsheet to see the timeline. Most of our projects run for six months or more.

Please pass this on to your product team.

Cheers,
Sofia Okonkwo

label_notes: clean feature (feature-gantt): a request for something the product does not do is P4; urgency low: no time pressure.
